Name: Guild Kill List
Author: yadm18
Description:
[b]Guild Kill List[/b]

After you reach floor 100 of the Mines, Marlon sends a letter and asks you to visit the Adventurer's Guild. On that visit he walks over to meet you, then tells you the monster eradication list is in your pack.

From then on, a button on the inventory screen opens the same list as the board on the guild wall.

[b]How you get it[/b]
[list]
[*]You can already enter the Adventurer's Guild, the way you normally would.[/*]
[*]You have reached floor 100 of the Mines.[/*]
[*]Marlon's letter is in the mailbox the next morning. Read it.[/*]
[*]Go to the guild. If another scene is already playing, his visit waits for another trip.[/*]
[*]You and Marlon walk toward each other. He tells you to open your inventory and check the list from anywhere.[/*]
[*]The button is there after that conversation. Skipping the scene still counts.[/*]
[/list]
[b]The button[/b]
[list]
[*]It sits in the column on the right of the inventory, with Organize and any other buttons there. It does not cover the item grid and it is not an item.[/*]
[*]The tooltip is "Monster Eradication Goals".[/*]
[*]Clicking it opens the guild's monster eradication list.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Options[/b]
With Generic Mod Config Menu installed, the toggle is "Show the guild list in inventory". It starts on. Without that mod, the button still appears once Marlon has given it to you.

[b]Notes[/b]
[list]
[*]Needs SMAPI 4.1.0 or newer, and Stardew Valley 1.6.14 or newer. No other mod is required.[/*]
[*]Works alongside Stardew Valley Expanded. Marlon in that guild is used for the visit.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Install[/b]
[list]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Install with Vortex, or unzip the folder into your Mods folder.[/*]
[*]You should have Mods/GuildKillList/manifest.json.[/*]
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Same mod as 1.1.1. Marlon's letter now arrives on a save that already reached floor 100, including while the Mines are dangerous. It is in the mailbox the same day. Unzip into Stardew Valley/Mods, or install the zip with Vortex.
